summary: Consolidated results for investigation OT-19-S0100, the VP10 aminoquinoline genotoxicity package for Valquessia Pharmaceuticals SpA. Control validity holds for the HepG2 viability screen, the bacterial mutation assay with and without S9 and the mammalian-cell micronucleus assessment. The bacterial assay is negative, but the mammalian scoring points to the same reactive side-chain concern across several articles. Valquessia have dropped that branch of the series.

rows.v: OT-19-S0100 VP10 genotoxicity package: consolidated results

comments.text: Consistent across the mammalian readouts, so the side-chain concern goes into the summary to Valquessia as written.
comments.author: Lucia Moretti

sheets.name: Cytotox
rows: HepG2 viability screen (ATP content), 24 h and 48 h exposure. Investigation OT-19-S0100.

sheets.name: Ames
rows: Bacterial mutation assay with and without S9. Mean revertants per plate, n=3. Fold is against the vehicle control on the same strain.
Control validity met for every strain. Bacterial result is negative, as stated on the summary.

sheets.name: Micronucleus
rows: Mammalian-cell micronucleus assessment (TK6). Treatment 3 h with and without S9, recovery to 24 h. Percent micronucleated cells, RPD against vehicle.
Side-chain concern: the signal repeats across the reactive analogues, not the parent series.

comments.text: Dropping the branch is Valquessia's decision. Our part is to state the concern plainly.
comments.author: Naomi Takamori
